Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:

1. Region is Buleleng Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Buleleng Regency. 3. Regent is the Regent of Buleleng.
4. Regional House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is the Regional Representative Council of Buleleng Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.
7. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and jdih.bulelengkab.go.id her child, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
9. Every person is an individual or corporation. 10. Violence is any act that results in suffering or affliction physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty. 11. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in suffering or affliction of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
12. Violence against children is any action that results or may result in the suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences suffering and or affliction either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
15. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
17. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
18. Service is an action carried out as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred. jdih.bulelengkab.go.id
19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.
20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence, both physically and psychologically.
21. Integrated Service Center for the Empowerment of Women and Children, hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A, is an Integrated Service Unit established by the Regional Government to carry out the functions and main tasks of integrated services for Women and Children Victims of Violence, including complaint services, Health Rehabilitation, Social Rehabilitation, Repatriation, Social Reintegration, and Legal Aid.
22. Minimum Service Standards, hereinafter abbreviated as SPM, is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, Social Rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal aid, as well as Repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children Victims of Violence.

Article 5

Letter a

What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and or causes death Letter b

What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Letter c

What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to produce money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the family's economic needs.

Letter d

What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of a person's life or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property

Letter e

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Letter f

What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:

a. actions that result in the failure to meet a child's needs properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of intentionally neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of a child as appropriate; jdih.bulelengkab.go.id
c. actions that neglect a person within the scope of their household, when according to the law applicable to them or due to agreement or contract they are obligated to provide life, care, or maintenance to that person;
d. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under that person's control.

Letter g

Sufficiently clear.

Letter h

What is meant by "threats of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without the use of means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to: a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children; b. protect Women and provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; and

c. empower women and children victims of acts of violence.

Article 18

(1) Every person may participate in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by:

a. reporting acts of violence against women and/or children; b. providing first aid to victims of Acts of Violence; c. independently socializing the rights of women and children; and/or
d. establishing independent community social institutions.

Article 12

(1) Empowerment of victims of acts of violence against women is conducted by the Regional Government in the form of:

a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and c. capital assistance.
(2) Empowerment of child victims of acts of violence is conducted by the Regional Government in the form of providing education, guidance, and counseling.
(3) Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) is implemented by Regional Apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.

Article 20

(1) The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of: a. socialization to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children; and b. assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

What is meant by "counseling" is the process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with guidance on interpersonal communication, counseling techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge jdih.bulelengkab.go.id aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine a way out or efforts to overcome these problems.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

II. ELUCIDATION ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 6

Every person who hears, sees, or knows of the occurrence of violence as referred to in Article 5 is obliged to make efforts to:

a. prevent the continuation of criminal acts;
b. provide protection to victims of acts of violence; c. provide emergency assistance; and/or
d. assist in the process of submitting an application for protection order. jdih.bulelengkab.go.id

Article 19

In the event that community social institutions implement protection of women and children from acts of violence, they are obligated to coordinate with P2TP2A.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

(3) Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) is implemented by Regional Apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

d. establishing independent community social institutions.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

II. ELUCIDATION ARTICLE BY ARTICLE

Article 6

Every person who hears, sees, or knows of the occurrence of violence as referred to in Article 5 is obliged to make efforts to:

a. prevent the continuation of criminal acts;
b. provide protection to victims of acts of violence; c. provide emergency assistance; and/or
d. assist in the process of submitting an application for protection order. jdih.bulelengkab.go.id

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to: a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children; b. protect Women and provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; and

c. empower women and children victims of acts of violence.

6. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.
7. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and jdih.bulelengkab.go.id her child, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
9. Every person is an individual or corporation. 10. Violence is any act that results in suffering or affliction physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty. 11. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in suffering or affliction of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
12. Violence against children is any action that results or may result in the suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences suffering and or affliction either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
15. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
17. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
18. Service is an action carried out as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred. jdih.bulelengkab.go.id

20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence, both physically and psychologically.
21. 22. Minimum Service Standards, hereinafter abbreviated as SPM, is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, Social Rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal aid, as well as Repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children Victims of Violence.

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to: a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children; b. protect Women and provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; and

c. empower women and children victims of acts of violence.

Article 5

Letter a

What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and or causes death Letter b

What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Letter c

What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to produce money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the family's economic needs.

Letter d

What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of a person's life or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property

Letter e

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Letter f

What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:

a. actions that result in the failure to meet a child's needs properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of intentionally neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of a child as appropriate; jdih.bulelengkab.go.id
c. actions that neglect a person within the scope of their household, when according to the law applicable to them or due to agreement or contract they are obligated to provide life, care, or maintenance to that person;
d. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under that person's control.

Letter g

Sufficiently clear.

Letter h

What is meant by "threats of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without the use of means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

(2) The Information and reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

CHAPTER IV

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

Article 18

(1) Every person may participate in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by:

a. reporting acts of violence against women and/or children; b. providing first aid to victims of Acts of Violence; c. independently socializing the rights of women and children; and/or
d. establishing independent community social institutions.

CHAPTER V

COOPERATION AND COORDINATION FOR THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to: a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children; b. protect Women and provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; and

c. empower women and children victims of acts of violence.

Article 19

In the event that community social institutions implement protection of women and children from acts of violence, they are obligated to coordinate with P2TP2A.

Article 24

(1) The Regional Government prepares and develops an information and reporting system for the protection of women and children from acts of violence.

(2) The Information and reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the provisions of Laws and Regulations.

Article 20

(1) The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of: a. socialization to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children; and b. assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

Article 12

(1) Empowerment of victims of acts of violence against women is conducted by the Regional Government in the form of:

a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and c. capital assistance.
(2) Empowerment of child victims of acts of violence is conducted by the Regional Government in the form of providing education, guidance, and counseling.
(3) Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) is implemented by Regional Apparatus in accordance with their duties and functions.

Article 5

Letter a

What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and or causes death Letter b

What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Letter c

What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to produce money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the family's economic needs.

Letter d

What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of a person's life or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property

Letter e

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Letter f

What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:

a. actions that result in the failure to meet a child's needs properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of intentionally neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of a child as appropriate; jdih.bulelengkab.go.id
c. actions that neglect a person within the scope of their household, when according to the law applicable to them or due to agreement or contract they are obligated to provide life, care, or maintenance to that person;
d. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under that person's control.

Letter g

Sufficiently clear.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

CHAPTER IV

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, the following terms shall mean:

4. Regional House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is the Regional Representative Council of Buleleng Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child who is still in the womb.
7. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and jdih.bulelengkab.go.id her child, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
9. Every person is an individual or corporation. 10. Violence is any act that results in suffering or affliction physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty. 11. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in suffering or affliction of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
12. Violence against children is any action that results or may result in the suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences suffering and or affliction either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
15. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
16. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
17. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
18. Service is an action carried out as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred. jdih.bulelengkab.go.id
19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.
20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence, both physically and psychologically.

22. Minimum Service Standards, hereinafter abbreviated as SPM, is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing services for handling reports/complaints, health services, Social Rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal aid, as well as Repatriation and social reintegration for Women and Children Victims of Violence.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.

The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble to the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects the entire Indonesian nation and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protection here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children who are victims of violence must have their honor and dignity protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children who are victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

Protection of women and children who are victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment for women and children who are victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.
